Its lightweight construction ensures you stay comfortable without being weighed down, whether you are hitting the trails or navigating the city.

  • Classic 1/4 zip closure for easy layering and quick temperature regulation.
  • Soft, lightweight fleece fabric designed for year-round comfort and breathability.
  • Streamlined fit that transitions easily from rugged outdoor activities to casual daily wear.
  • Durable construction built to withstand active use and frequent travel.
  • Minimalist aesthetic that pairs seamlessly with technical gear or everyday staples.

Built for those who value both function and style, this fleece provides reliable performance across various environments. Its packable nature makes it a go-to choice for weekend trips and unpredictable weather conditions. Experience a high-quality layer that meets the demands of an active lifestyle while maintaining a clean, classic look.

body_html:

Garrett Danielson: Designer of Masu Tee

Colorado native and owner/operator of Pine Printshop, Garrett draws inspiration from everything from mid-century advertising to American folk art. With bold, hard-hitting graphics, his work reflects the same grit and community that fuels Pine’s presses.

Find Garrett on the internet: @pinebrand

Audrey Rauth: Photo Credit

Born on the shores of Lake Michigan and now rooted in the Rockies, I spend my time chasing light and searching for bunches of sky pilots in the high alpine. If I’m not tracing lines on a map to find new trail link-ups, I’m running those same ridge-lines at dawn with my camera in hand, so many snacks in my pack, and the biggest smile on my face. My photo work is rooted in the gratitude I feel for and joy I get from these wild places.

Find Audrey on the internet: @audrey.rauth
